SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Oh? Yu-jeong!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あっ、ユジョンさん！
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Hã? Yujeong!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوه؟ یو-جئونگ!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Yuman!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ユマンさん！！
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Senhor Yumán!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: یومان!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Were you out grocery shopping?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 買い物の帰りですか？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Tá voltando das compras?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: برای خرید مواد غذایی بیرون بودید؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 네! 먹을 거랑 떨어진 거 이것저것 좀 샀어요!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Yeah! I bought some food and restocked a few things we were out of!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 嗯！买了些吃的还有零碎的一些日用品
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 嗯！買了些吃的還有一些生活用品
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: はい！食べ物とか、切れてたものをちょっと買ってきました！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Iya! Aku beli bahan makanan dan stok ulang barang-barang yang udah habis!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Sim! Comprei comida e algumas coisinhas que tinham acabado.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¡Sí! Compré comida y algunas cosas que se habían acabado.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آره من مقداری غذا خریدم و چند چیز را که از اونا خارج شده بودیم دوباره ذخیره کردم!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Let me carry them for you!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 俺が持ちますよ！
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Deixa eu te ajudar a carregar!
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: بگذار اونا رو برای تو حمل کنم!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Ah, it’s okay!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ、大丈夫ですよ！
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ah, não precisa.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آه، اشکالی ندارد!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 아이, 그럼 하나만이라도 들게 해 줘요!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: At least let me carry one bag then!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 哎呀，就让我帮忙拿一样嘛！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: え〜、じゃあせめてひとつだけでも持たせてください！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Minimal satu kantong aja deh, ya?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Vamos lá, pelo menos me deixa levar uma sacola.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Vamos, al menos déjame llevar una bolsa.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: لااقل بذار یه کیسه حمل کنم!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Hmm…
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: うーん…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Mmm...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: هوم…

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Then, could you take just this one?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: じゃあ、これだけお願いします
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kalau gitu, yang ini aja ya?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Então leva essa, por favor.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: سپس، می توانید فقط این یکی را بردارید؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 그 시험 공부는 잘 돼가요? 일 때문에 시간 많지 않을텐데.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Is your exam study going well? You don’t have much time because of work, right.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 考试复习还顺利吗？工作这么忙，应该没什么时间吧
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 那個...考試準備得順利嗎？因為工作的關係，時間應該不多吧
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 試験勉強はうまく進んでますか？仕事もあって時間あまりないでしょう
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Belajarnya lancar? Soalnya kamu kan kerja juga, waktunya pasti sempit.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: E como vão os estudos? Com o trabalho, deve não sobrar muito tempo.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: ¿Y cómo va el estudio? Con el trabajo seguro no tienes mucho tiempo.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: مطالعه امتحانی شما خوب پیش می رود؟ شما به دلیل کار وقت زیادی ندارید، درست است.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I’m studying whenever I can!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我都利用空檔時間在看書！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 合間を見てやってます！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aku belajar kapan pun ada waktu!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Eu estudo quando dá, entre um tempinho e outro.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Lo hago cuando puedo, entre ratos.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: هر وقت بتونم دارم درس میخونم!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 요즘에는 일하는 것도 재밌고, 집에 가는 것도 재밌어요!
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: These days, working is fun — and going home is fun too!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 最近觉得上班也有趣，回家也开心！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 最近不只上班很有趣，回家也很有趣！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 最近は仕事も楽しいし、家に帰るのも楽しいんです！
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Akhir-akhir ini, kerja jadi menyenangkan — dan pulang ke rumah juga jadi hal yang aku tunggu!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Ultimamente tenho gostado muito de trabalhar… e também de voltar pra casa.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Últimamente disfruto mucho trabajar… y también volver a casa.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: این روزها، کار کردن سرگرم کننده است - و رفتن به خونه نیز سرگرم کننده است!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 저 하숙집 진짜 잘들어온 거 같아요.
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I think moving into the boarding house was really the right decision.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我觉得来这个合租公寓真是来对了
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我覺得來合宿公寓住真的是來對了
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: この下宿に入って本当によかったです
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kayaknya pindah ke rumah kos ini emang keputusan yang tepat banget.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Acho que fiz muito bem em me mudar pra pensão.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Creo que hice muy bien en mudarme a la pensión.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: فکر می کنم انتقال به پانسیون واقعا تصمیم درستی بود.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: What about you, Yuman?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: ユマンさんはどうですか？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Mas o senhor...
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: تو چی، یومان؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Me moving in...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 私が下宿に入ったの
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Não se arrepende
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: من در حال حرکت در ...

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Do you regret it?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 後悔してませんか？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: de ter me convidado pra ficar?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: پشیمونی؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Huh? Regret?
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: え？後悔ですか？
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Arrepender?
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: ها؟ پشیمانی؟

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 네... 전 다른 사람들처럼 활발하지도 않고...
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Yeah… since I’m not lively or outgoing like the others…
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 是啊...我既不像别人那么活泼...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 嗯...我不像其他人那麼活潑
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: はい…私、他の人みたいに明るくないし…
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Iya… soalnya aku nggak ceria atau rame kayak yang lain...
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Sim… eu não sou tão animada quanto os outros,
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Sí… no soy tan animada como los demás,
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: آره... چون من مثل بقیه سرزنده یا اهل رفتار نیستم...

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I’ve been told I’m gloomy a lot.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 還總是被人說陰沉沉的
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 地味だってよく言われるから…
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: e muita gente diz que eu tenho um ar meio triste…
SCRIPT.SPANISH: y muchos dicen que tengo un aire algo triste…
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: به من گفته اند که خیلی عبوس هستم.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: So I was worried you might regret taking me in.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 怕你说不定会后悔收留我...
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 我擔心你會不會後悔收留我...
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: もしかして後悔してるんじゃないかと思って
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Jadi aku khawatir kamu nyesel udah nerima aku tinggal bareng.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Tinha medo de que isso te incomodasse.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Tenía miedo de que eso le molestara.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: بنابراین نگران بودم که از پذیرش من پشیمان شوید.
